name: How do contractors handle height differences between different flooring types?

mainEntity.name: How do contractors handle height differences between different flooring types?

acceptedAnswer.text: Managing transitions between differing floor heights requires careful planning during subfloor preparation. Differences in thickness between thick porcelain tile and thinner vinyl planks can create tripping hazards if not addressed early. Contractors resolve this by adjusting underlayment thickness, using self-leveling compounds, or installing beveled hardwood or metal transition profiles. Coordinating your flooring choices as part of a cohesive home or bathroom remodel ensures adjoining surfaces meet flush and look intentional throughout doorways and room openings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contractors adjust underlayment thickness, use leveling compounds, and install custom transition strips so different materials meet safely and flush at doorways.
